description: Three-level T-type inverter. Watch neutral-point balance, THD, and bidirectional switch stress.

pathologies.explanation: Three-phase amplitude or phase imbalance. Check dq decoupling, PLL, and neutral-point balancing.
THD exceeds spec. Check LCL filter, active damping, dead-time. T-type zero-level path has different impedance than NPC — verify dead-time is not causing excessive distortion.
Output dead — check DC bus, gate drive, bidirectional switch enable, and modulation.
